verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a public API for controlling Airbyte programmatically, including use with orchestrators like Airflow and token-based access. A Terraform provider and PyAirbyte add further code-driven configuration paths. Nothing in the evidence claims the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and the Connector Builder is described specifically as a UI tool; the docs-path OpenAPI probe 404s don't contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of the Connector Builder and AI Assistant workflows, an easily discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
